mcqs.question: The 79th BAFTA Film Awards 2026 were held on which date and at which venue, with whom as host?
options: 22 February 2026, Royal Festival Hall, London; Alan Cumming
22 February 2026, Royal Festival Hall, London; Paul Thomas Anderson
29 May 1949, Royal Festival Hall, London; Alan Cumming
22 February 2026, BBC headquarters, London; Alan Cumming
mcqs.explanation: The 79th BAFTA Film Awards were held on 22 February 2026 at Royal Festival Hall, London, and hosted by Alan Cumming. Paul Thomas Anderson was the Best Director winner, not the host.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the 79th BAFTA Film Awards 2026, consider the following statements:
1. One Battle After Another was the biggest winner with six awards.
2. Boong won the Children’s & Family Film award.
3. Hamnet won the Outstanding Debut (British) award.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: One Battle After Another won six awards, and Boong won the Children’s & Family Film award. Statement 3 is incorrect because Hamnet won Outstanding British Film, while My Father’s Shadow won Outstanding Debut (British).

mcqs.question: Which one of the following statements about the 79th BAFTA Film Awards 2026 and BAFTA is incorrect?
options: Donna Langley received the BAFTA Fellowship.
Clare Binns received the Outstanding British Contribution to Cinema award.
BAFTA has its headquarters in London.
The official name since 2013 is the British Academy Film Awards.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the official name since 2013 is the British Academy Film Awards. The correct official name is EE British Academy Film Awards; Donna Langley, Clare Binns and London headquarters are correctly stated.
